defects.title: BIM floor geometry regressed to zero
defects.root_cause: getBim2dPlanView reads getDiscoveredRoomVolumes() <- cachedModelSemantics.rooms, only hydrated by refreshModelSemantics() which was driven ONLY by the Clinical Program discovery effect (runs only when enabled). CP Off => semantics never hydrated => 0 rooms.
defects.secondary_seam: getBim2dPlanView defaulted storeyId to programState.activeStoreyId (Clinical Program storey) not the walker's active storey (violated storey truth section 8).

defects.title: Walker shows position + direction but not progression
defects.root_cause: Bim2dPlanPanel projected position + heading on each walkthrough state but kept NO trail history; no app-owned trail existed.

defect_1_fix: spatialAssetOverlay.ensureBim2dPlanRoomsHydrated(): triggers existing idempotent in-flight-guarded refreshModelSemantics() WITHOUT enabling Clinical Program; no second room registry.
getBim2dPlanView storey precedence: opts.storeyId ?? (walker.active ? walker.activeStoreyId : undefined) ?? programState.activeStoreyId.
Bim2dPlanPanel: on 0-room projection, call ensureBim2dPlanRoomsHydrated() once (guarded) then re-project.
defect_2_fix: Bim2dPlanPanel: app-owned WalkthroughTrail state advanced from authoritative walkthrough samples; renders subdued-green polyline per active-storey segment BEHIND the bright walker marker; heading indicator kept separate.
trail_sampling_rules: append only on >= MIN_STEP_M XY translation
turn/pitch/FOV produce zero XY translation => never extend
teleport >= JUMP_M => new segment, no connector
new session (active false->true) => new segment, prior history kept
breakTrailSegment => new segment at next sample (targeted entry/reset)

preserved: exact-vs-approximate (dashed) footprint provenance and honest counts
room click selects same bimSpaceId, never moves walker
mini-plan UX (no Fit/+/- toolbar, x close -> reopen chip)

forward_requirement_recorded_not_impleme.requirement: Equipment containment: validate equipment envelopes within parent room authoritative geometry and surface a PASS/FAIL cue on the 2D plan, reusing the existing equipment validation authority.
